8 завдань НМТ формату на тему шкільного: 8 NMT-style tasks about school life, friends and social media.
З підметом «my best friend» (третя особа: With the subject «my best friend» (third person singular), the verb in Present Simple always takes -s / -es. So speak → speaks.
Маркер «last summer» точно вказує на зав: The marker «last summer» points to a finished moment in the past, so we use Past Simple: went. We don’t use Present Perfect with markers like this.
Дія сталася ДО іншої минулої дії («the l: The action happened BEFORE another past action («the lesson started»), so we use Past Perfect: had finished.
Про плани на найближче майбутнє говоримо: We talk about plans for the near future with Present Continuous: are you doing. This is the most natural and common option in spoken English.
Другий тип умовного речення (нереальна/м: Second conditional (an unreal or unlikely situation): if + Past Simple, would + V. So «got», not «get».
Процес почався в минулому («since Monday: The process started in the past («since Monday») and is still going on, so we use Present Perfect Continuous. For this state («not working») we use exactly this form.
Пасивний стан у Present Simple: is / are: Passive voice in Present Simple: is / are + V3. Here «TikTok is used», meaning people use it, it doesn’t do anything itself.
У reported speech час «зсувається» на од: In reported speech the tense «shifts» one step back into the past. Direct: «I will come.» → Reported: «She said she would come.»
Reading про трейлери і серіали плюс use: Reading about trailers and TV series plus use of English. 8 tasks in the NMT format.
Абзац A: «viewers scrolling on their pho: Paragraph A: «viewers scrolling on their phones decide almost instantly whether to keep watching». The text says nothing about price, bans or fans’ requests. In the NMT the correct answer is always based on a specific sentence.
Абзац B: «editors move the most exciting: Paragraph B: «editors move the most exciting scene to the very beginning». Move to the beginning and put at the start mean the same thing: the NMT loves paraphrasing.
Вона каже: «it only has to make you curi: She says: «it only has to make you curious». Option D is a trap: a teaser «works like» a poster, meaning it has a similar role, not that it looks the same. The full trailer «still exists», so B doesn’t fit either.
Ключове речення: «They are better at jud: Key sentence: «They are better at judging quickly whether something is worth their time». Option A says the exact opposite: the author says teenagers are «not simply less patient».
In one night, тобто за одну ніч, у межах: In one night means within one night, inside that time period. At night means «during the night» in general, and on is used with dates and days: on Friday night.
Look forward to: тут to це прийменник, а: Look forward to: here to is a preposition, not part of the infinitive. After a preposition we always use -ing: looking forward to watching.
Дія тривала до іншої минулої події (trai: The action continued up to another past event (trailer came out) and lasted for some time (for months). This is Past Perfect Continuous: had been talking.
Друга частина «would have won» показує н: The second part «would have won» shows an unreal past, so this is a third conditional. The if-part uses Past Perfect: had been.
